bug.actual_behavior: The generated AGENTS.md title becomes an env-var comment and replaces the existing instruction to read AGENT_GUIDE.md.
evidence: Generated title was derived from an env-var comment and the prior AGENT_GUIDE.md entry instruction was removed.
bug.expected_behavior: Auto initialization derives a meaningful project name and preserves existing nonstandard but critical agent instructions during intelligent merge.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run the initializer with --auto in a repository whose README contains an .env example before a conventional title parse succeeds.
Use an existing AGENTS.md whose critical instructions are outside the generator standard Chinese headings.
bug.summary: Auto analysis misidentifies a README env-var example as the project name and overwrites existing agent-entry instructions during merge.
bug.workaround: Review the diff, then manually restore project-specific agent entry rules and a correct project title.
